coverage: All 54 source models classified by operation; generic chatbot aliases and dynamic event bindings resolved. This is the full supported API surface, not approval to grant dormant modules in the actual deployment.
operation_rules: SELECT covers predicates, row locks and Prisma RETURNING projections.
Nested connect requires target reads, not REFERENCES; PostgreSQL FK cascades run internally, not runtime child DELETE grants.
Optional-module profiles require allowlisted deployed configuration evidence before selecting exact grants.
Each relation's runtime_privileges belongs to its profile; optional_profiles contains additive privileges requiring separate deployment confirmation, never a table-wide profile switch.
No DELETE on permanent NEXI evidence; no direct trigger-function EXECUTE.
